plugin_description: Registers a Tizen widget for Samsung Smart TV
settings.title: Samsung TV Widget
settings.description: Install Avalon on a Samsung Smart TV as a Tizen widget, URL Launcher app, or Media Station X start parameter. Set the LAN address of this server so the TV can open the web client.
settings.public_url: Public server URL for the TV
settings.install_steps: 1) Enable Developer Mode on the TV (Apps → 1-2-3-4-5). 2) Install the .wgt via Tizen Studio / sdb, or add the Widget URL in URL Launcher. 3) Optional: point Media Station X to msx/start.json.
